# ProductCard

The product tile for category grids, search results and "you may also like" rows.

`IK.ProductCard` · Shopping

## Use

```jsx
<IK.ProductCard title="…" price={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.ProductCard" title="…" price="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |

| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `vendor` | `string` |  |
| `price` * | `number` | Selling price in major units (rupees). |
| `compareAt` | `number` | Original price; shows struck through with "% off" when higher than price. |
| `images` | `[string, string?] \| string[]` | [main photo, hover photo]. Second is optional. |
